messages.content: ENISA activated, Italy & Spain confirm incidents, IMO emergency session in 72h. Mediterranean security and governance architecture is the central policy question.
Post-Incident Analysis: 5 critical systemic gaps identified. Delay in CERT notification, no BCP testing, lack of real-time IoC sharing, legal gaps for flags of convenience, GPS/AIS not in SOLAS.

questions.question: EU/NATO + POLITICAL CELL — REGIONAL ARCHITECTURE (D-04)

options.label: A → Propose EU-mandated Mediterranean Maritime CERT (6-month timeline)
B → Strengthen France-Italy-Spain bilateral framework first
C → Immediately integrate Southern Mediterranean states into unified structure
D → Mandate IMO binding international cyber-maritime standard via SOLAS

questions.note: A Mediterranean Maritime CERT provides institutional capabilities while a binding IMO standard provides global normative leverage.
